SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS total_refunds_dollars
FROM refunds;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_signed_up
FROM customers
WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND signup_date < '2026-01-01';

SELECT name, price_minor / 100.0 AS list_price_dollars
FROM products
ORDER BY price_minor DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.country AS country_code, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.country;

SELECT
    p.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price_minor * oi.quantity), 0) / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.category;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered
FROM orders
WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT topic, ROUND(AVG(satisfaction), 2) AS average_satisfaction
FROM tickets
WHERE satisfaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY AVG(satisfaction), topic
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(r.id) AS refund_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE c.country = 'Netherlands'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

SELECT topic, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
FROM tickets
WHERE order_id IS NULL
GROUP BY topic;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'audio' COLLATE NOCASE;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_order_lines
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.unit_price_minor < p.price_minor;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
      AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT
    c.segment,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.id
   AND o.status = 'delivered'
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.segment;

SELECT
    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
        AS cancelled_percentage
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT id, category, name, units,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, name AS product_name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, product_name, id;

SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

SELECT
    topic,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(resolved_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(opened_at))), 2) AS avg_resolution_days
FROM tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY topic;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT o.id,
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_average
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_minor > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_minor) FROM order_values);

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    (COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor) / 100.0 AS total_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.shipping_minor
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) + o.shipping_minor DESC,
         o.id ASC
LIMIT 3;
